description: 200 body of POST /items/{itemId}/returned (operationId markItemReturned). Finder only. The answer is the updated item in the same shape as GET /items/{itemId}: status is RETURNED and returnedAt is set, with a fresh 15-minute photo link (the caller is the finder, so a wallet-id photo is allowed). No finder ID and no email. 403 (not the finder), 404 and 409 (already returned) use shared/error.json.
